Headquarters: Argentina (Remote)

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.

This is a fully remote, long-term contract position open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.

Our Core Technologies Include:

Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc

What You’ll Do: 

• Develop test automation at the pace of feature development utilizing AI tools and our functional and performance test frameworks

• Utilize LLMs to create feature test plans and internal knowledge stores for streamlining AI tools usage for Automation and Deep testing efforts

• Define custom AI workflows to enable all developers to test new features using existing automation tests, evaluate test failures, and troubleshoot environment issues

• Execute functional/performance tests by spinning up disposable environments on demand to deploy microservices with different versions and configurations, and customize database content

• Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production

• Analyze log files and troubleshoot production issues by automating and reproducing them in a non-production environment

• Collaborate with QA platform to create solutions for feature validations and test automation for your product

What We Look For:

• Ability to develop test automation in Java using Selenium/Playwright to utilize Integrated Development environments (IDE) such as IntelliJ or Eclipse, with and without Coding assistants

• Experience in deploying services in various environments such as Kubernetes, using deployment tools like ArgoCD and Jenkins

• Capability to improve efficiency of existing test infrastructure using Docker, Playwright and headless browser executions

• Familiarity with log aggregators such as SumoLogic or Kibana, and app monitoring tools such as Honeycomb or Grafana

• Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment

• Comfortable working in Agile methodology

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-senior-qa-automation-engineer-heloc-latam

Headquarters: Remote, US

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager who will manage high-complexity projects to successful completion from initiation through delivery to closure. In this role, you will coordinate with cross-functional teams and our global customers to complete distinct projects both on time and within budget. You will be responsible for driving customer engagement operations that raise the bar for how JFrog Professional Services consultants interact with customers, resources, systems, and data to optimize engagement delivery. Project Managers need to have substantial experience managing software projects and relying on traditional systems and software development methodologies, as well as practical experience with agile project management methodologies.

The ideal candidate will possess a mix of technical consulting, and software development or DevOps project management experience . In this role, you will work cross-functionally, own several small, medium and large projects, and be committed to driving outcomes for customers by following JFrog delivery best practices and continuously improve the process.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager in JFrog you will... 

• Develop and manage projects from ideation through execution, including project scope, timeline, and project execution, and coordinate closely with engineers and Architects.

• Proactively develop and manage a backlog of user stories or activities to drive a project forward.

• Address bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.

• Provide consistent, executive-level reporting on project status and outcomes to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Demonstrate effective communication skills (both verbal and written) across all levels of the business.

• Contribute to the long-term direction for optimizing project delivery in professional services.

To be a Senior Technical Project Manager in JFrog you need...

• Knowledge of specific industry project management and technical delivery methodologies for software (e.g., Project Management Institute (PMI) methodologies, agile/scrum, and/or software SDLC).

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or related field.

• Demonstrated progressive experience working as a project manager on Software Delivery or complex technical projects with enterprise customers. 

• Experience using various project management and/or agile tools.

• Demonstrate strong communication skills across all levels of the business from technical partners to senior leadership.

• Demonstrated experience with structured thinking to proactively recognize business challenges, map business processes, gather business requirements, evaluate tools, develop roadmaps, devise/recommend solutions, and communicate complex ideas.

• Self-starter attitude with the ability to work with very little guidance and direction.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strict attention to detail.

• Understanding of software development lifecycle, preferably experience in an agile and/or DevOps environment.

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

• At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.

• This position has a base salary range between $145,000 to $155,000.  Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

• Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.

• This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

• JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

• JFrog embraces hybrid work: 3 days in office / 2 days remote.

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.
We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:
• 
Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.
• 
Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.
• 
Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.
• 
Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.
• 
Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.
• 
Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.
• 
Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.
Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

Requirements
We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:
• 
Expertise in Python.
• 
A strong background in backend development.
• 
Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.
• 
Strong test design and security fundamentals.
• 
Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.
• 
The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.
Bonus:
• 
Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems
• 
Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.
• 
Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.
• 
Experience with Kubernetes.
Location
Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot: 

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
The Opportunity 

Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot's platform continues to grow. In this role, you'll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.

If you're energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

• Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution

• Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals

• Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team

• Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility

• Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy

• Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team's effectiveness

• Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area

• Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success

• Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process

• Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team

• Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

About You 

You likely have:

• 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus

• A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution

• Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership

• Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits

• Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products

• Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows

• Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

Why This Role Matters 

As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.

This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot's Product organization operates as it matures.

Interview Process 

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

• Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes

• Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes

• Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $168,000-$198,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

## About the Role

We are looking for a rigorous, systems-minded quantitative leader to own our core commercial intelligence engine end-to-end. This is not a traditional dashboard-building or BI reporting seat. You will define, build, and encode the mathematical logic, unit-economic models, and predictive forecasting systems that power our product and drive real commercial decisions for our brands.

You will sit at the intersection of **finance, data science, and product engineering**, turning complex commercial data, messy founder inputs, and predictive models into defensible, automated product logic and AI agent workflows.

## Key Accountabilities

### 1. Proprietary Systems: Growth Forecasts & P&Ls

- **Growth Forecasting:** Build and own the methodology that takes a brand’s current performance and projects a defensible 12-month forecast, complete with a rigorous assumption set.
- **Financial Architecture:** Construct brand-level P&Ls directly from the forecast, mapping revenue, COGS, contribution margin, and operating costs.
- **Variance & Calibration:** Continuously run models against real outcomes, measure errors, track actuals against projections, and explain every variance.

### 2. Productization & Agentic Workflow Design

- **Product Logic:** Translate sophisticated financial and statistical models into production-ready product logic so the system calculates and delivers outputs natively.
- **AI Agent Specification:** Define what data agents compute, what internal data/benchmarks they draw on, and what assertions they are strictly barred from making.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Orchestration:** Replace manual validation with automated product rules while establishing clear review gates for human sign-off before deliverables ship.
- **Data Schemas & Engineering Collaboration:** Specify data structures, validation rules, and pipelines across structured commercial inputs, partnering directly with engineering to bring models to life in production.

### 3. Decision Framing & Commercial Rigor

- **Decision-First Modeling:** Design every analysis backwards from the specific commercial decision it is meant to change.
- **Uncertainty & Stated Confidence:** Size uncertainty statistically, state clearly what sparse or self-reported data *cannot* support, and attach a stated confidence level to every output.
- **Benchmark Library Management:** Define and version the benchmark repository (category, stage, market) to evaluate brands accurately even when data is sparse.

### 4. Enablement & Commercial Communication

- **Cross-Functional Communication:** Present complex numbers, models, and uncertainties to founders and operators with clarity and authority.
- **Quantitative Literacy:** Raise the analytical bar across the business by teaching teams how to read and interpret model outputs correctly.
- **Documentation & Standards:** Write airtight documentation and standards for data/finance deliverables so cross-functional delivery teams can execute autonomously.

## What This Seat Is Not

- **Not a BI/Reporting Seat:** Dashboards are merely one downstream output of this work; your primary focus is proprietary modeling and product architecture.
- **Not Research Without Action:** We judge models by the decisions they actually changed, not academic complexity.
- **Not a Data Engineering Seat:** You will specify pipelines, schemas, and logic for engineering to build—you won't be maintaining core infrastructure tables yourself.

## Ideal Background & Qualifications

### Must-Haves

- **Experience:** 6–8 years in growth, marketing, commercial, or product analytics within DTC, e-commerce, marketplaces, or specialized platforms.
- **Proven Track Record:** End-to-end ownership of a forecasting, unit-economics, or media-mix model that commercial teams relied on for high-stakes budget or strategic decisions. You can name the decisions your model changed and what followed.
- **DTC Unit Economics Mastery:** Deep fluency in CAC, AOV, COGS, contribution margin, LTV, payback period, breakeven, retention cohorts, and working capital reconciliation.
- **Modelling with Incomplete Data:** Demonstrated ability to build robust outputs from banded, self-reported, or partial founder inputs while explicitly quantifying confidence levels.
- **Statistical Rigor:** Strong foundation in sizing uncertainty, managing sample limitations, and maintaining analytical integrity.
- **Technical Depth:** Hands-on daily fluency in **SQL and Python**.
- **Product & Engineering Collaboration:** Experience working directly with engineering teams to turn quantitative models or metric definitions into production software.
- **Communication:** Exceptional presence and ability to defend underlying assumptions and model uncertainty under direct challenge.

### Nice-to-Haves

- Media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, or causal measurement methodologies.
- Applied machine learning experience (forecasting, propensity, or segmentation models in production).
- Experience evaluating generative AI or multi-agent system outputs.
- Familiarity with modern data stack layers (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt) and attribution platforms (Triple Whale, Northbeam, Rockerbox).
- Exposure to multi-brand ecosystems via agency, consulting, or platform environments.
- Experience in early-stage product environments where models and products were co-developed from scratch.
